tests.reason: The gates are inert on staging until JEV_COMMUNITY_ENABLED opens the member plane (held until the TypeSafe DPA), and reaching them needs a member action (posting an intent, a notification, a calendar run) that a read-only staging probe must not cause. Decisions, gating, sampling, state without names, agreement, fire-and-forget wiring after the final result, and the staging-only pins are proven by this suite.
